decision.summary: The screened region (610–675) contains a prolonged E descent (610–659) followed by an abrupt E reversal (660–664). The descent lacks a clear opposing return within the allowed context [575,710]; the reversal is incomplete and co-occurs with continuing N decline and elevated U, preventing confirmation of a closed temporary offset. Both intervals are classified uncertain due to ambiguous recovery and cross-axis complexity.

intervals.observation: E shows sustained descent from ~610 to 659 (≈4 MAD), with N gradually declining and U rising; interior is coherent and monotonic in E, but cross-axis trends diverge—no return observed within allowed context.

E reverses sharply upward starting at 660, peaking by 664; N continues downward through this interval, U remains elevated—return in E is partial and not yet stabilized; no full recovery to pre-descent level observed before 665.
